    SUM(SUM(CAST(oi.order_quantity AS INTEGER) * p.product_price)) OVER (ORDER BY strftime('%Y-%m', co.order_date) 
        ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_revenue
FROM Customer_Orders co
JOIN high_freq hf ON co.customer_id = hf.customer_id
JOIN Order_Items oi ON co.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN Products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', co.order_date)
ORDER BY strftime('%Y-%m', co.order_date);
